abstract: Six cases of immature teratoma of the ovary were karyotyped and analyzed for chromosomal heteromorphisms, enzyme polymorphisms, and HLA specificities to determine their mechanism of origin. Three cases were chromosomally abnormal, with karyotypes of 48,XX, +14, +21; 47,XX, +20; and 47,XXX, respectively. The tumors with 48,XX, +14, +21 and 47,XX, +20 karyotypes were heterozygous for chromosomal heteromorphisms which were identical to those of their host and therefore originated from a premeiotic cell or failure of meiosis I. Both had a poor prognosis. The 47,XXX tumor and the three cases with normal karyotypes were homozygous for chromosome heteromorphisms and either homozygous or heterozygous for enzyme and HLA markers and therefore originated from a failure of meiosis II or duplication of a mature haploid ovum. All four had an uneventful postoperative course. These observations show that immature teratomas are like cystic teratomas in having at least three separate mechanisms of origin. However, they are unlike cystic teratomas in having a high proportion with chromosome abnormalities and a high rate of malignant transformation.
abstract_ja: ヒト卵巣未熟奇形腫6例について核型分析を行い、染色体多型、酵素多型、HLA特異性を解析して発生機序を検討した。3例は染色体異常を示し、核型は48,XX,+14,+21、47,XX,+20、47,XXXであった。48,XX,+14,+21および47,XX,+20の腫瘍は、宿主と同一の染色体多型をヘテロ接合で有しており、減数分裂前の細胞または減数第一分裂の失敗に由来すると考えられた。両例とも予後不良であった。47,XXXの腫瘍と核型が正常な3例は、染色体多型がホモ接合性で、酵素およびHLAマーカーはホモ接合性またはヘテロ接合性であった。これらは減数第二分裂の失敗、または成熟半数体卵子の重複に由来すると考えられた。4例とも術後経過は良好であった。これらの知見は、未熟奇形腫が嚢胞性奇形腫と同様に少なくとも3通りの発生機序を有することを示している。しかし嚢胞性奇形腫と異なり、未熟奇形腫では染色体異常を示す割合が高く、悪性転化の頻度も高い。
